form.title: Variant Calling - Custom Genome (nf-core/sarek)
form.description: Perform variant calling on unaligned sequence reads using a custom reference FASTA

workflow_version.title: Workflow Version
workflow_version.description: Version of nf-core/sarek to run (e.g. 3.8.1). See https://nf-co.re/sarek/releases for all releases.

analysis_type.title: Experiment Design
analysis_type.description: Select the reference genome, the assay type and the variant callers. Normal samples get germline calls; a tumor is called against its patient's normal, or alone when its patient has none.

fasta.title: Reference Genome
fasta.description: To add a new genome, upload as Reference Genome (FASTA) on the Manage References page

wes.title: Whole Exome/Targeted Gene Panel Assay
wes.description: Please indicate if your data was generated using a capture kit.

intervals.title: Genomic intervals
intervals.description: (optional) Target BED file in case of whole exome or targeted sequencing or intervals file for parallelization.

tools.title: Variant calling tool(s)
tools.description: Select one or more variant callers. Normal samples are called by CNVkit, DeepVariant, FreeBayes, HaplotypeCaller, Manta, mpileup, Strelka and TIDDIT. A tumor is called against its patient's normal by CNVkit, FreeBayes, Manta, Mutect2, Strelka and TIDDIT, or alone (no normal for that patient) by FreeBayes, LoFreq, Manta, mpileup, Mutect2, TIDDIT and, with a Genomic intervals file, CNVkit.

germline_resource.title: Germline resource (Mutect2)
germline_resource.description: (optional) Population allele frequencies for this genome (bgzipped VCF with an AF field), which Mutect2 needs to filter its calls. Without it, Mutect2's calls are left unfiltered. Upload it as a Germline Resource File on the Manage References page.

pon.title: Panel of normals (Mutect2)
pon.description: (optional) Panel-of-normals VCF (bgzipped) for this genome, used by Mutect2 to filter recurrent technical artifacts. Upload it as a Germline Resource File on the Manage References page.

read_trimming_options.title: Read Trimming Options
read_trimming_options.description: Parameters for performing adapter and read trimming using Trim-Galore.

clip_r1.title: Clip R1
clip_r1.description: Instructs Trim Galore to remove bp from the 5' end of read 1 (or single-end reads).

clip_r2.title: Clip R2
clip_r2.description: Instructs Trim Galore to remove bp from the 5' end of read 2 (paired-end reads only).

three_prime_clip_r1.title: Three Prime Clip R1
three_prime_clip_r1.description: Instructs Trim Galore to remove bp from the 3' end of read 1 AFTER adapter/quality trimming has been performed.

three_prime_clip_r2.title: Three Prime Clip R2
three_prime_clip_r2.description: Instructs Trim Galore to remove bp from the 3' end of read 2 AFTER adapter/quality trimming has been performed.

trim_nextseq.title: Trim NextSeq
trim_nextseq.description: DetectS polyG in read tails and trim them. Corresponds to the FastP flag `--trim_poly_g.`

save_trimmed.title: Save the trimmed FastQ files in the results directory?

aligner.title: Aligner
aligner.description: Specify aligner to be used to map reads to reference genome.

alignment_format.title: Alignment Format
alignment_format.description: File format used to save aligned reads

extra_params_json.title: Extra Parameters (JSON)
extra_params_json.description: Optional: provide additional workflow parameters as a JSON object (e.g. {"skip_markduplicates": true}). Parameters are validated against the nf-core/sarek schema for the selected workflow version — unrecognized keys are silently removed.

schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per pair of R1 and R2 FASTQ files. Rows with the same sample, such as one per sequencing lane, are merged by the pipeline. Give a tumor and its matched normal the same patient to call them as a pair.

patient.title: Patient
patient.description: Leave blank to use the sample name. A tumor is paired with the normal sample of the same patient

sex.title: Sex
sex.description: Leave blank if unknown (NA). Values such as male/female or M/F are converted to XY/XX

status.title: Status (0 = normal, 1 = tumor)
status.description: 0 for a normal sample, 1 for a tumor. Leave blank for normal. Values such as Normal/Tumor are converted to 0/1

sample.title: Sample
sample.errorMessage: Sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

lane.title: Lane
lane.description: Leave blank to number the rows of each sample automatically

fastq_1.title: FASTQ (R1)
fastq_1.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read

fastq_2.title: FASTQ (R2)
fastq_2.errorMessage: Must be a gzipped read FASTQ (.fastq.gz or .fq.gz) with no spaces in its name, not an I1/I2 index read
